cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY' >/tmp/ackstruct.json
import json,sys,struct
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from wire import packet,seal
base=bytearray(packet(0,0,ack=True))
def rr(desc,mut,reseal=True):
 f=bytearray(base);mut(f)
 if reseal:f=seal(f)
 return desc,bytes(f)
items=[]
items.append(rr('baseline',lambda f:None))
items.append(rr('ack_lo',lambda f:f.__setitem__(slice(58,62),struct.pack('!I',0x1f000002))))
items.append(rr('ack_top',lambda f:f.__setitem__(slice(58,62),struct.pack('!I',0x1e000001))))
items.append(rr('bth_apsn_top',lambda f:f.__setitem__(slice(50,54),struct.pack('!I',0x01000000))))
items.append(rr('extra_body',lambda f:f.__setitem__(slice(38,40),struct.pack('!H',32))))
# add 4 bytes body before icrc: easiest reconstruct from valid ack internals?
# mut opcode to DATA and APSN top
items.append(rr('op_data',lambda f:f.__setitem__(42,4)))
items.append(rr('apsn_data',lambda f:f.__setitem__(50,0x80)))
items.append(rr('qtop',lambda f:f.__setitem__(46,1)))
items.append(rr('udpc',lambda f:f.__setitem__(slice(40,42),b'\x12\x34')))
ev=[]
for desc,fr in items:
 ev.append({'op':'wire','rank':0,'hex':fr.hex()});ev.append({'op':'snap','tag':desc})
c={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':1,'words':1,'capacity':1,'start':0,'events':ev,'trace':0}
print(json.dumps({'cases':[c]}))
print([x[0] for x in items],file=sys.stderr)
PY
